name: mcp-remote-static
description: Connects MCP clients to remote servers using static OAuth 2.0 client authentication. It is specifically designed for marketplace scenarios that require pre-registered client IDs and secrets through standard authorization code flows.

rawRecord.description: Connects MCP clients to remote servers using static OAuth 2.0 client authentication. It is specifically designed for marketplace scenarios that require pre-registered client IDs and secrets through standard authorization code flows.

host.description: Callback server hostname. Defaults to localhost.

header.description: Custom HTTP request headers in 'HeaderName: value' format.

transport.description: Transport strategy. Valid values: sse-only, http-only, sse-first, http-first. Defaults to http-first.

ignore_tool.description: Ignore specified tools. Use multiple times in arguments or provide tool names.

auth_timeout.description: OAuth callback timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

callbackPort.description: Callback server port number. Defaults to 17091.

static_oauth_client_info.description: Static OAuth client information. Can be a JSON string like '{"client_id":"xxx","client_secret":"yyy"}' or a file path starting with '@' like '@/path/to/oauth_client_info.json'

rawRecord.name: mcp-remote-static
